meta.name: story-review
meta.description: 多视角对抗式审查。full/lean 模式在已部署 reviewer agents 时并行 spawn；缺失/异常 agents 或 spawn 失败时自动降级 solo，参考文件不可读时使用内置 rubric fallback。触发方式：/story-review、/审查、「审查一下」「帮我审一下」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个智能体对抗式审查故事，自动汇总多视角改进建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你写了故事想要多角度的批评与建议
copy.tagline_en: Let agents review your story from adversarial angles for diverse suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want diverse feedback on stories you've written

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会从结构、角色、文字、设定等角度审查小说文本，输出带严重度分级、原文证据和修改建议的问题清单。它只给建议不改文件；有条件时并行调用多个审稿助手，否则自动降级为当前会话单独审查。
howto.when: 当你说「帮我审一下」「审查一下」或输入 /story-review 等指令、要审查小说文本时触发；也可加 full、lean、solo 指定模式。

say.text: 帮我审一下第三章，看结构和节奏有没有问题
say.note: 会走 full 模式并行审稿，输出分级问题清单

say.text: /story-review lean 只看设定一致性和结构
say.note: 只调用两个 Agent，不查文字自然度

say.text: 审查一下最近改的章节，用 solo 模式
say.note: 不调用 Agent，由当前会话直接审

howto.what_en: Claude reviews fiction from structure, character, prose, and consistency angles, outputting graded findings with evidence and fixes. It never edits files; full/lean modes spawn reviewer agents, falling back to solo if unavailable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a story review, e.g. with /story-review, /审查, or phrases like 「帮我审一下」, with optional full/lean/solo mode parameters.

say_en.text: Review chapter 3 for me, check structure and pacing.
say_en.note: Runs full review and outputs graded findings.

say_en.text: /story-review lean, only check consistency and structure
say_en.note: Spawns only two agents; prose naturalness is not checked.

say_en.text: Review the recently edited chapters using solo mode
say_en.note: No agents spawned; the current session reviews directly.
